load_model_weights: load PyTorch model weights from a checkpoint file path into a BaseModel instance
create_base_model_subclass: create a subclass of BaseModel that inherits the load method for loading model state dicts
review_base_model_load: review the BaseModel load method to understand how it handles optimizer and model keys in checkpoints
refactor_base_model_load: refactor the BaseModel load method to support additional checkpoint formats beyond optimizer and model keys
